description: This file defines the ExternalMessageBuilder interface, which provides a builder pattern for constructing instances of ExternalMessage, including methods for setting headers, payload, authorization, source, enforcement, and other message-related properties.

classes.name: ExternalMessageBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building ExternalMessage instances with methods to set headers, payload, authorization, source, enforcement, and other message properties.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds a single header key-value pair to the message being built.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds multiple headers to the message being built.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets the message headers, replacing existing headers.

methods.name: withText
methods.description: Sets a text payload and sets payload type to TEXT; for use mainly by producers.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array payload and sets payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets a ByteBuffer payload and sets payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and byte array payloads, payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and ByteBuffer payloads, payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Associates an AuthorizationContext with the message.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Associates a TopicPath with the message.

methods.name: withEnforcement
methods.description: Associates Enforcement data with the message; null to disable.

methods.name: withHeaderMapping
methods.description: Associates header mappings with the message; null to disable.

methods.name: withSourceAddress
methods.description: Adds the source address from where the message was received.

methods.name: withSource
methods.description: Adds the source object where the message was received.

methods.name: asResponse
methods.description: Marks the message as a response message.

methods.name: asError
methods.description: Marks the message as an error message.

methods.name: withInternalHeaders
methods.description: Attaches internal headers from the signal that created this message for error responses.

methods.name: withPayloadMapping
methods.description: Defines which payload mappings are applied to this message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ExternalMessage instance.
